capabilities: Syncs every campaign's session recaps into chronicle notes
Creates wiki pages for NPCs, locations, items and factions
Turns entity names and relations into wikilinks
Protects text below the %% kazkar:end %% marker from edits
Matches notes by kazkar_id so moves and renames survive
extras: API key is kept in Obsidian's secret storage (system keychain), not data.json; no telemetry; GM-only transcripts are never synced; free Kazkar plan works.
problem: Session recaps and campaign lore recorded by the Kazkar Discord bot live outside the vault, with no way to view them as linked Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: Pull your tabletop RPG sessions out of Kazkar and into your vault as linked notes

summary: Sync plugin that pulls TTRPG session recaps and lore entities from Kazkar into Obsidian as linked notes.
